title: Enantioselective Synthesis of Homochiral Hierarchical Nd8Fe3-Oxo Cluster from Racemic Nd9Fe2-Oxo Cluster

material_class.structural_family: hierarchical chiral Nd8Fe3-oxo cluster assembling into a supramolecular double helix

synthesis.procedure: Presynthesized racemic {Nd9Fe2} (0.01 mmol, 50 mg) was dissolved in 3 mL of MeOH and (1R,2R)-1,2-diphenylethane-1,2-diol (R-L; 21.40 mg, 0.1 mmol) was added. The mixture was sealed in a 10 mL vial, stirred for 2 h at room temperature, and filtered. Light-yellow crystals of R-1 formed after 7 days at 2–6 °C.
synthesis.temperature: stirred at room temperature; crystallized at 2–6 °C
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 10 mL sealed vial; stir then filter
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; light-yellow crystals obtained after 7 days at 2–6 °C

properties.summary: UV–vis absorption and CD spectra confirm ligand-to-cluster chirality transfer. R-1 shows a nearly perfect CD mirror image versus S-1, with strong positive Cotton effects at 363, 401, and 456 nm and a weak positive Cotton effect at 550 nm, corresponding to the 350–500 nm UV–vis envelope.

measurements.name: CD Cotton effect
measurements.value: strong positive at 363, 401, and 456 nm; weak positive at 550 nm
measurements.conditions: solution CD of R-1; mirror image of S-1

measurements.name: UV–vis absorption envelope associated with CD bands

material_class.structural_family: hierarchical chiral Nd8Fe3-oxo cluster assembling into a supramolecular double helix

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to R-1: presynthesized racemic {Nd9Fe2} (0.01 mmol, 50 mg) was dissolved in 3 mL of MeOH and the S-hydrobenzoin ligand (S-HL) was used in place of R-HL. The mixture was sealed in a 10 mL vial, stirred for 2 h at room temperature, filtered, and crystallized at 2–6 °C over 7 days.

reagents.name: S-hydrobenzoin (S-HL / S-L)
reagents.amount: same as R-L procedure (21.40 mg, 0.1 mmol implied)

synthesis.temperature: stirred at room temperature; crystallized at 2–6 °C
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 10 mL sealed vial; stir then filter (same as R-1)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; crystals obtained after 7 days at 2–6 °C

properties.summary: S-1 is the CD enantiomer of R-1: opposite Cotton effects at 363, 401, 456, and 550 nm with nearly perfect mirror symmetry over 350–500 nm, matching the UV–vis envelope. Crystal-structure analysis of S-1 (P1) was used as the representative enantiomer.

measurements.name: CD Cotton effect
measurements.value: opposite (mirror-image) signals at 363, 401, 456, and 550 nm versus R-1

measurements.name: UV–vis absorption envelope associated with CD bands
